# Exceed v0.7.5 - Table of Contents

> A high-level stream-oriented MS Excel OpenXML (`.xlsx`) generator

## Pages

- [Phoenix Integration](https://exceed.hexdocs.pm/phoenix.md)
- [Exceed](https://exceed.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://exceed.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Exceed](https://exceed.hexdocs.pm/Exceed.md): Exceed is a high-level stream-oriented library for generating Excel files,
useful when generating spreadsheets from data sets that exceed available
memory (or the memory that one wishes to devote to generating Excel files).
- [Exceed.Workbook](https://exceed.hexdocs.pm/Exceed.Workbook.md): The top-level data structure that collects worksheets and metadata for
generating an Excel file.
- [Exceed.Worksheet](https://exceed.hexdocs.pm/Exceed.Worksheet.md): Worksheets represent the tabular data to be included in an Excel sheet, in
addition to metadata about the sheet and how it should be rendered.

- Protocols
  - [Exceed.Worksheet.Cell](https://exceed.hexdocs.pm/Exceed.Worksheet.Cell.md): A protocol for transforming source data into data structures that can be streamed
to appropriate SpreadsheetML tags, using the `XmlStream` library.

- Utilities
  - [Exceed.Util](https://exceed.hexdocs.pm/Exceed.Util.md): Helpers for converting Elixir data formats to Excel.

- Exceptions
  - [Exceed.Error](https://exceed.hexdocs.pm/Exceed.Error.md)
